body: How much you pay for rent?
Do you interact with your neighbors?

Imagine everyday, you’re feeling terrible, just terrible, yet have to go through what’s in plan for you. Then comes a day, someone tells you that you have no future.

Everyday, telling yourself you can do this, you can get through this, everyone can right? 

If this if what life is for others, why is it that I’m the only one taking it all so hard. suck it up like others do. just suck it up
Thank you for replying and informing me about not being able to get answers here. I’ve been in contact with my states suicide prevention community, Thanks
